newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bond spreads blow-out vs dlr bloc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bond spreads blow-out vs dlr bloc.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads blew out sharply against other dollar bloc bonds as the local market came under pressure after the Reserve Bank left the prospect of a further policy easing uncertain, traders said.
The central bank said in its quarterly Bulletin that a cut would be dependent on wages growth and was disappointed that some wage agreements had been based on higher than actual inflation levels.
Domestic bonds had been fully pricing in a 50 basis point rate cut when the RBA board meets on November 5.
The Australian/U.S. 10-year spread widened to its highest level in over 2-1/2 weeks at 114 basis points and having started the week at sub-100 basis points.
Australia's 10-year spread to New Zealand also went to a premium for the for the first time since end-July.

The New Zealand bond market has been enjoying a strong rally since the start of the week following last weekend's election, albeit with an inconclusive result, and after Tuesday's softer than expected inflation reported.
However, the rally there was slightly tarnished after the RBNZ ruled out any further easing in monetary conditions at this stage.
